children: Coinglass data shows that whale positions on Hyperliquid total $10.51 billion, with long positions at $5.02 billion, or 47.73%, and short positions at $5.50 billion, or 52.27%. According to ChainCatcher, long positions show unrealized profit of $795 million, while short positions show unrealized loss of $849 million.
A whale address, 0x5b5d..60, is currently holding a 5x isolated short on ETH opened at $2,303.58, with an unrealized loss of $47.22 million.

title: Hyperliquid Whale Positions Reach $10.51 Billion, With Shorts Slightly Outweighing Longs
